name: SM_Gold_Pile_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: heap of about 950 gold coins, 36 cm across and 11 cm high, with strays round the foot
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: Coins are placed on a mound by rule, not settled by simulation, so some float a little or cut into their neighbours. The game mesh is a smooth mound with the heap baked onto it, the 55 coins that stand proudest as real twelve-sided discs (they break the outline; the first version was a clean dome) and the eighteen strays; between the discs there is no parallax at 1 m. A voxel skin over all the coins was tried and read as crumpled foil. Over the soft triangle target of a small prop for the discs. No gems, bag or chest.
